options.label: Radar size
options.description:
Scales the whole radar, icons included. 100% is the game's own size.

+ makes it bigger and - smaller while playing; hold a key to keep resizing. Keys can be changed in RadarPlus.ini.

options.label: Radar shape
options.description:
Sets the shape of the radar.

Circle is the game's own round radar.

Square shows more of the map in the corners, and icons at the edge follow the square.

Rounded is a square with rounded corners.

options.label: Lock rotation
options.description:
Keeps north at the top of the radar instead of turning it with the camera.

The map and icons stay put while the view cone and your marker turn. Works with every radar shape.

options.label: Radar icons
options.description:
Sets which icons the radar shows.

None leaves a clean minimap and compass: just the map, north and your marker.

Objective shows only the tracked (yellow) objective.

Pins shows the tracked objective and your own map pins.

Markers adds other quests, bounties and map markers.

All shows the game's full radar, with friends and enemies.

Custom lets you pick icons one by one, right here in this panel (with a mouse).

options.label: Radar range (metres)
options.description:
Distance covered by the radar's inner ring, in metres. The game's default is 40.

Lower values zoom in, higher values show a larger area. Icons and the map scale together.

Page Up zooms in and Page Down zooms out while playing. Keys can be changed in RadarPlus.ini.

options.label: Icon distance (metres)
options.description:
Hides radar icons further away than this, so zooming out doesn't flood the radar. The tracked objective and your own map pins always show.

At 900, the maximum, every icon shows.

options.label: Map overlay
options.description:
Draws the area map under the radar.

Open the full map once in each area so RadarPlus can learn its map tiles. After that it is remembered.

options.label: Map overlay opacity
options.description:
How strongly the map shows under the radar, in percent.

Needs Map overlay turned on.

options.label: Radar background
options.description:
Darkens the area behind the radar for contrast, in percent.

0 keeps the game's look.

options.label: World markers
options.description:
Shows the radar's icons over the actual objects in the world.

None hides all world markers.

Objective shows only the tracked (yellow) objective.

Pins shows the tracked objective and your own map pins.

Markers adds other quests, bounties and map markers.

All adds friends and enemies.

Custom lets you pick icons one by one, right here in this panel (with a mouse).

The tracked objective waits at the edge of the screen while it is off screen.

options.label: Marker size
options.description: Size of the world markers, in percent.

options.label: Marker distance (metres)
options.description:
Hides world markers further away than this. The tracked objective and your own map pins always show.

Only objects within the radar's range get a marker, so a longer radar range shows more.

options.label: Distance labels
options.description: Shows the distance in metres under each world marker.

options.label: Hide in combat
options.description:
Hides the world markers while you're in combat, the tracked objective too.

They come back a moment after the fighting stops, so they don't flicker between waves.

options.label: Main map icons
options.description:
Sets which icons the main map (the map screen) shows.

None leaves just the map and your own marker.

Objective shows only the tracked (yellow) objective and its area.

Pins shows the tracked objective and your own map pins.

All shows every icon, like the game.

Custom lets you pick icons one by one, right here in this panel (with a mouse).
